description: ONE verdict for AI outreach: can this North American number receive SMS, and is now a reasonable time to send? Returns sms_capable (live line-type read), VoIP flag, spam reputation, the recipient's approximate local time with an 8am-9pm calling-window flag, and plain-language reasons. Deliverability and reputation signals only — not a legal compliance determination (no DNC/reassigned-number/litigator data).
name: vri_sms_deliverability

ok_to_message_now.description: sms_capable AND clean AND inside the calling window

reasons.description: Plain-language reasons this number is or is not a good send. Empty means nothing is wrong. When reputation is against the number these also carry the evidence behind it (complaint counts and recency, complaint category, community reports, recent porting) and a closing "reputation confidence: low|medium|high" line.

sms_capable.description: Wireless line that can receive SMS

title: SMS Deliverability Check
